depiction.primary_object: two identical person busts separated by a vertical bar
modifiers: thick vertical dividing line between the two figures
depiction.composition: symmetrical side-by-side figures with central vertical divider, front view

readings.meaning: separation, division, or boundary between people
office partition, cubicle wall, or acoustic divider
separate user profiles, accounts, or permissions

ambiguity: Can be mistaken for a restroom sign at a quick glance, though both silhouettes are identical gender-neutral busts rather than male/female full-body figures.

reasoning: Shows two person busts divided by a solid vertical wall, clearly conveying separation, partitions/cubicles, isolated profiles, or interpersonal boundaries. It fits a focused set of tasks around splitting accounts, installing room/desk dividers, mediation, or quarantine, though at small sizes it can be confused with a generic 1-on-1 meeting or restroom sign.
